water_management.label: Water Management
water_management.description: A source-to-reuse pathway for water protection, supply, treatment, WASH and post-use management.

nodes.label: Water Protection
nodes.description: Protect water sources and catchments from contamination and degradation.

nodes.label: Water Conservation
nodes.description: Reduce unnecessary water use and improve water-use efficiency.

nodes.label: Water Harvesting
nodes.description: Capture available water from rain, runoff or other local sources.

nodes.label: Water Storage
nodes.description: Store water safely between collection and distribution or treatment.

nodes.label: Water Distribution
nodes.description: Move water from a source or storage point to users and service points.

nodes.label: Water Purification
nodes.description: Remove or inactivate contaminants to make water safer for intended use.

nodes.label: Water Treatment
nodes.description: Apply treatment processes such as disinfection, coagulation, biological treatment or desalination.

nodes.label: WASH & Sanitation
nodes.description: Connect safe water with sanitation and hygiene practices at the point of use.

nodes.label: Wastewater Management
nodes.description: Collect, contain, treat and safely manage wastewater, greywater, blackwater and fecal sludge.

nodes.label: Water Reuse
nodes.description: Safely reuse recovered water or treated effluent for appropriate purposes.

agriculture_food_security.label: Agriculture & Food Security
agriculture_food_security.description: A practical pathway from soil and seed systems through cultivation, water use, post-harvest handling and food access.

nodes.label: Soil Management
nodes.description: Improve soil fertility, structure, moisture retention and land stewardship.

nodes.label: Seed Systems
nodes.description: Preserve, select, multiply and exchange locally appropriate planting material.

nodes.label: Cultivation
nodes.description: Grow crops using locally adapted techniques, tools and knowledge.

nodes.label: Agricultural Water
nodes.description: Provide water through irrigation, harvesting and efficient field practices.

nodes.label: Harvest & Post-Harvest
nodes.description: Reduce losses through harvesting, drying, storage and primary processing.

nodes.label: Food Processing
nodes.description: Transform crops and agricultural outputs into usable or marketable food products.

nodes.label: Food Access
nodes.description: Strengthen local food availability, affordability, resilience and community access.

energy_access.label: Energy Access
energy_access.description: Local energy pathway from resource and generation through conversion, storage, distribution and end use.

nodes.label: Energy Resources
nodes.description: Identify locally available renewable or recoverable energy resources.

nodes.label: Energy Generation
nodes.description: Generate useful electricity or heat from local resources.

nodes.label: Energy Conversion
nodes.description: Convert energy into a form suitable for local applications.

nodes.label: Energy Storage
nodes.description: Store energy for continuity, mobility or demand balancing.

nodes.label: Energy Distribution
nodes.description: Deliver electricity or energy services to homes, farms and community facilities.

nodes.label: Productive Energy Use
nodes.description: Apply energy to productive, household, agricultural or community needs.

health_medical_access.label: Health & Medical Access
health_medical_access.description: Community health pathway from prevention and basic diagnosis to local treatment support and rehabilitation.

nodes.label: Prevention & Hygiene
nodes.description: Reduce avoidable illness through hygiene, prevention practices and community health action.

nodes.label: Screening & Diagnosis
nodes.description: Identify health conditions using accessible screening or diagnostic tools.

nodes.label: Medical Tools
nodes.description: Provide low-cost, improvised or locally manufactured tools for care.

nodes.label: Care Delivery
nodes.description: Support frontline care and practical treatment in local settings.

nodes.label: Referral & Logistics
nodes.description: Move patients, supplies and information safely through the care pathway.

nodes.label: Rehabilitation & Support
nodes.description: Support recovery, mobility, continuity and long-term function.

construction_shelter.label: Construction & Shelter
construction_shelter.description: Built-environment pathway from materials and design through construction, sanitation, resilience and habitable shelter.

nodes.label: Local Materials
nodes.description: Use locally available, recycled or low-cost building materials.

nodes.label: Design & Adaptation
nodes.description: Adapt building forms to local climate, hazards, skills and resources.

nodes.label: Construction
nodes.description: Build or retrofit structures using accessible methods and local skills.

nodes.label: Water & Sanitation Infrastructure
nodes.description: Integrate water, drainage and sanitation systems into the built environment.

nodes.label: Resilience & Safety
nodes.description: Improve structural, environmental and occupant safety.

nodes.label: Habitable Shelter
nodes.description: Provide safe, usable and durable places for people and communities.

education_communication.label: Education & Communication
education_communication.description: Learning pathway from access and learning tools through teaching, communication and community knowledge sharing.

nodes.label: Learning Access
nodes.description: Expand access to learning opportunities where infrastructure is limited.

nodes.label: Learning Tools
nodes.description: Provide low-cost, offline or repurposed tools that enable learning.

nodes.label: Teaching Support
nodes.description: Support teachers, facilitators and peer learning with adaptable methods.

nodes.label: Communication
nodes.description: Enable community communication and information exchange.

nodes.label: Knowledge Sharing
nodes.description: Capture and circulate practical, local and experiential knowledge.

nodes.label: Learning Outcomes
nodes.description: Translate access and learning into skills, agency and practical capability.

tools_manufacturing.label: Tools & Manufacturing
tools_manufacturing.description: Making pathway from local materials and fabrication through adaptation, prototyping, repair and useful production.

nodes.label: Local Inputs
nodes.description: Use locally available raw, reclaimed or repurposed materials.

nodes.label: Fabrication
nodes.description: Fabricate components and tools using local workshops and practical skills.

nodes.label: Adaptation
nodes.description: Modify existing equipment or tools to fit local needs and constraints.

nodes.label: Prototyping
nodes.description: Build and test working prototypes before wider use.

nodes.label: Repair & Maintenance
nodes.description: Extend useful life through repair, maintenance and component reuse.

nodes.label: Productive Tool
nodes.description: Deliver a practical tool or machine that solves a local production problem.

environment_circular_economy.label: Environment & Circular Economy
environment_circular_economy.description: Environmental pathway from prevention and collection through recovery, treatment, reuse and ecological restoration.

nodes.label: Prevention & Reduction
nodes.description: Reduce resource use and prevent waste or environmental damage at source.

nodes.label: Collection
nodes.description: Collect waste and recoverable materials from households and communities.

nodes.label: Sorting & Recovery
nodes.description: Separate materials for reuse, recycling or productive recovery.

nodes.label: Treatment & Processing
nodes.description: Process wastes into safer, reusable or transformed outputs.

nodes.label: Reuse & Circularity
nodes.description: Return materials, nutrients or products into productive cycles.

nodes.label: Ecosystem Restoration
nodes.description: Restore environmental quality, soil, waterways and ecosystem functions.

transport_mobility.label: Transportation & Mobility
transport_mobility.description: Mobility pathway from local transport needs through vehicle adaptation, logistics and accessible movement.

nodes.label: Mobility Need
nodes.description: Identify local transport, access and mobility constraints.

nodes.label: Vehicle Adaptation
nodes.description: Modify or repurpose vehicles and components for local use.

nodes.label: Mobility Tools
nodes.description: Deploy bicycles, carts, boats or other locally appropriate mobility tools.

nodes.label: Local Logistics
nodes.description: Move people, goods, food, water or medical supplies efficiently.

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.description: Improve access for people, communities and essential services.

nodes.label: Mobility Outcome
nodes.description: Deliver safer, more affordable and appropriate movement.

finance_social_innovation.label: Finance & Social Innovation
finance_social_innovation.description: Community resilience pathway from local organization and finance through cooperation, digital access and collective outcomes.

nodes.label: Local Organization
nodes.description: Organize community actors, cooperatives and local institutions around shared needs.

nodes.label: Community Finance
nodes.description: Mobilize savings, rotating funds, barter or local finance mechanisms.

nodes.label: Digital Access
nodes.description: Use digital tools and mobile services to extend access and coordination.

nodes.label: Collective Action
nodes.description: Turn shared resources and knowledge into coordinated local action.

nodes.label: Social Enterprise
nodes.description: Create practical services or enterprises that sustain community solutions.

nodes.label: Community Resilience
nodes.description: Strengthen local capacity, livelihoods, inclusion and adaptive resilience.
